label: s32_st_theo_admits_it
title: Wrong About the Crate
summary: Callback. Theo is wrong about something small, safely, in front of somebody who does not make it a lesson -- which the character bible says is what he needs and what he has never had. The player can decline to give it to him; that branch is written to cost something. Threshold lowered from 12 to 8 after measurement: 12 is the midpoint of the reachable range and, combined with the flag, put the payoff in one run in ten. A callback nobody sees is not a callback.
